title: asplenium pellucidum subsp. pseudohorridum
intro: Asplenium pellucidum subsp. pseudohorridum, commonly known as the "False Horrid Brake Fern", is a rare and endangered species of fern found in tropical regions. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, gout, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Asplenium pellucidum subsp. pseudohorridum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
